'''Fallenspire Stronghold''' was a bunker stronghold used by the [[Death's Claw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang as their primary base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. It was named after the wreckage of the ''[[Endar Spire]]'', which sat just south of the stronghold. A number of Republic soldiers who were captured by the pirates were imprisoned there, but [[Havoc Squad]] tracked down the missing soldiers and rescued [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Tane]] and the other captives. [[Elara Dorne]] and her [[Search and Rescue Squad 204]] then escorted the survivors to safety.
